decision.summary: Within allowed context [550,650], the only candidate temporary offset is a sustained N-elevation from index 590 to 612, with ambiguous return: N declines after 612 but does not clearly revert to pre-590 baseline before index 650; E and U show correlated but non-symmetric responses, insufficient to confirm a closed temporary offset. No other intervals meet criteria for confirmed temporary offset.

intervals.observation: N shows elevated plateau from ~590 to 612 (centered ~5.5–6.5 MAD), rising gradually from ~585 and declining after 612; E and U exhibit lagged, opposing fluctuations (E dips ~595–605, U rises ~595–605) but no clean return on N coincident with those cross-axis features. Return phase is incomplete/ambiguous beyond 612 within allowed context.
